Questions, answered.

Still stuck? Real people answer, 24/7.

Visit the Help Center
What happens if I blow my funded account?

If your funded account is closed, you don’t have to start over. You can restore it with a Funded Reset, available up to three times per account.

Can I move to live market execution?

Advancement is reviewed individually, case by case, and is never guaranteed. Traders who meet certain criteria on their simulated funded accounts may be moved to a Professional Stage (Pro) account. From a Pro account, you may become eligible for a live market execution environment after meeting either of these milestones: submitting a payout request under the Professional Stage payout rules, or reaching $5,000 in recognized profit in your Pro account. If you qualify, our live team will contact you about next steps. Meeting these milestones does not mean the move happens right away.

What is a simulated funded account?

A simulated funded account is a sim account: your orders never reach a live market. Trade within the plan rules and you can request payouts, paid by Funded Family One.

How much has Funded Family One paid out to traders?

Funded Family One has paid more than $31 million to traders and updates its payout total every month. Every payout is published publicly as it happens, so anyone can verify the payout history for themselves.

Who is behind Funded Family One?

Funded Family One is led by CEO Manuel Meraz and backed by a global team of 50+ professionals. Our 24/7 human support team is here to help traders whenever they need assistance.

How much does it cost to get a funded futures account?

Evaluations currently start at $17.90 a month with code FFONE; prices depend on current promotions and can change. No plan charges an activation fee, so once you pass, your simulated funded account costs nothing extra.

What can I trade?

You can trade a wide range of CME-listed futures, including the S&P 500, Nasdaq, crude oil, natural gas, gold, and silver. We also support many commodity futures that most prop firms don’t offer. You can find the full list of supported contracts in our Help Center.

What makes Funded Family One different?

No activation fee on any plan. No daily loss limit on most plans. News trading allowed on most plans. Commodity futures as well as the majors. A 90/10 profit split. Accounts are monitored from day one, and most payouts are reviewed the same day. Prime has no consistency rule on the evaluation, and neither does Premier+ with Fast Pass.

Where are you based, and who can trade?

We’re headquartered in Temecula, California, USA. Our programs are available to traders from most countries around the world. Due to legal, regulatory, and compliance requirements, we cannot accept customers who reside in or are citizens of certain countries and regions. The full list is in our Help Center and may change as sanctions, regulations, and compliance requirements are updated.

We started Funded Family One in 2024 for futures traders with the skill but not the capital. You prove yourself in a simulated evaluation with rules that reward discipline.

Trust is earned one payout at a time.

When I founded Funded Family One, my goal wasn’t simply to create another proprietary trading firm. My goal was to build a company that traders could genuinely trust, one that earns its reputation through consistency, transparency, and doing the right thing.

Every payout we process, every support ticket we answer, every platform improvement we release, and every promise we keep is another opportunity to earn that trust.

My vision has never been to build the biggest prop firm. My vision is to build the most trusted one.

A company traders confidently recommend to their friends and colleagues because they know they’ll be treated fairly, supported by people who care, and backed by a team that stands behind its word.

That commitment influences every decision we make today and every decision we’ll make in the future. We’ll continue listening, improving, and raising the standard for what a proprietary trading firm should be.

Thank you for placing your trust in us. We’re honored to be part of your trading journey, and we’re excited for what we’ll accomplish together.

Manuel Meraz

Important Disclosures

General information only. All content provided by Funded Family One ("FFONE"), whether on our website, Help Center, dashboard, emails, social media, YouTube channel, livestreams, or any other communication, is provided for educational and general informational purposes only (the "Information"). The Information is not an offer or solicitation to buy or sell futures or any other financial instrument, and it is not trading, investment, tax, or legal advice, a recommendation, a trading strategy, or an endorsement of any financial instrument, company, or fund. The Information does not take into account your personal financial situation, objectives, or risk tolerance. Do your own research and consult a qualified financial adviser before making any financial decision. The Information is not directed at any particular jurisdiction and may not be used in any way that would violate local laws or regulations.

Simulated trading. All Evaluation Accounts and Funded Accounts offered by FFONE are simulated trading accounts. Trading in these accounts takes place in a simulated environment using simulated market data, and no orders are executed in live financial markets. Any reference to a "Funded Account" on our website, dashboard, emails, certificates, Help Center, or marketing materials means a Simulated Funded Account. It is not a live brokerage account, a live trading account, or customer-owned funds. Account balances, profits, losses, and performance shown in these accounts are simulated. Payouts are determined solely under FFONE's rules and payout program, and are not distributions of trading profits earned in live markets. Purchasing an evaluation or account is a fee for access to our simulated evaluation program and tools; it is not a deposit or an investment, and those fees are not used to trade in live markets on your behalf.

Professional Stage and live market trading. Advancement to FFONE's Professional Stage, or to live market execution, is not automatic and is never guaranteed. Every advancement is reviewed individually by our Risk Management Team, and meeting a published benchmark does not by itself qualify a trader. Live market participation may require additional documentation and broker processing, and may be unavailable to residents of certain countries for regulatory or compliance reasons, even where simulated accounts are available.

CFTC Rule 4.41: Hypothetical or simulated performance. Hypothetical or simulated performance results have certain limitations. Unlike an actual performance record, simulated results do not represent actual trading. Because the trades have not actually been executed, the results may have under- or over-compensated for the impact, if any, of certain market factors, such as lack of liquidity. Simulated or hypothetical trading programs in general are also subject to the fact that they are designed with the benefit of hindsight. No representation is being made that any account will or is likely to achieve profits or losses similar to those shown. In addition, hypothetical trading does not involve financial risk, and no hypothetical trading record can completely account for the impact of financial risk in actual trading, such as the ability to withstand losses or to stay with a trading plan despite losses.

Payout figures and examples. Payout totals, payout screenshots, and payout examples shown by FFONE (including any "total paid to traders" figure) reflect payouts made under FFONE's simulated-account payout program as of the date stated. They are not a promise or prediction of what any trader will receive. Most traders who purchase an evaluation do not receive a payout. Any trade examples shown for illustration are hypothetical and should not be taken as representative of live trading results.

Risk of trading. Trading futures and other leveraged products involves substantial risk and is not suitable for everyone. You can lose some or all of the money you put at risk, and in live markets losses can exceed your initial investment. Only use risk capital, meaning money you can afford to lose without affecting your financial security or lifestyle. Futures are traded on margin, which magnifies both gains and losses, and prices can be highly volatile. During fast markets, news events, or outside regular trading hours, it may be difficult or impossible to execute orders at the prices you want. Past performance, simulated or actual, is not indicative of future results.

Testimonials. Testimonials, reviews, payout posts, and trader stories, including those shared on Trustpilot, social media, or YouTube, may not be representative of the experience of other FFONE customers and are not a guarantee of future performance or success. No compensation has been provided in connection with any testimonial shown by FFONE.

No regulated services. Funded Family One operates as an e-commerce business. It is not a broker-dealer, futures commission merchant, introducing broker, commodity trading advisor, commodity pool operator, or investment adviser, and is not registered as any of these with the U.S. Commodity Futures Trading Commission (CFTC), the National Futures Association (NFA), or the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission. FFONE does not accept customer funds for trading, does not hold customer deposits, and does not provide individualized trading advice.

Third-party platforms and providers. Trading platforms and data services made available through FFONE, including NinjaTrader, Tradovate, TradingView, WealthCharts, and Rithmic, are owned and operated by independent third parties. Their names and trademarks belong to their respective owners, and their availability, performance, and fees are governed by their own terms. FFONE is not responsible for outages, data errors, or execution issues caused by third-party platforms. Payouts are processed through our third-party payout provider, Rise (Riseworks), and may be subject to identity verification (KYC) and fees set by that provider.

Eligibility and restricted regions. FFONE's services are not available to residents of certain countries and regions, as listed in our Help Center (Restricted Countries / Regions). It is your responsibility to ensure that your use of FFONE's services complies with the laws of your jurisdiction.

Accuracy. Funded Family One does not warrant the accuracy or completeness of the Information and is not responsible for any loss or damage arising from reliance on it. Program rules, plans, pricing, and payout terms may change; the current Terms & Conditions and Help Center articles govern in the event of any conflict with this disclosure or with marketing materials.
